words.enDefinition: examining data with summaries and other techniques to discover patterns, inconsistencies and questions worth investigating

examples.en: We used exploratory data analysis to compare temperature readings across buildings before suggesting any explanation for the differences.
examples.zh: 我们先用「探索性数据分析」比较各楼宇的温度读数，再尝试解释差异。

examples.en: Our exploratory data analysis showed that most missing responses came from two sessions held on the same day.
examples.zh: 我们的「探索性数据分析」发现，大多数缺失答复来自同一天的两场活动。

words.enDefinition: transforming, joining and reorganising data from its original form to make it usable for a task

examples.en: The data wrangling stage combined the weekly sign-in lists and moved the dates into a single column.
examples.zh: 「数据整理」阶段合并了每周签到名单，并将日期移到同一列。

examples.en: Our group finished the data wrangling before comparing attendance across events that used different registration forms.
examples.zh: 我们组完成「数据整理」后，才比较使用不同报名表的活动的出勤情况。

words.enDefinition: finding and handling missing values, errors, duplicates or inconsistencies in a dataset

examples.en: We did the data cleaning before counting survey responses because several forms had been submitted twice.
examples.zh: 有几份问卷重复提交了，所以我们先做「数据清洗」，再统计答复。

examples.en: The data cleaning step caught a month entered as thirteen in the practice timetable.
examples.zh: 「数据清洗」步骤发现练习日程表里有一个月份被填成了十三。

words.enDefinition: data prepared in a form that meets the requirements of a specific analysis

examples.en: We saved an analysis-ready dataset after documenting why a few rows remained outside the final study sample.
examples.zh: 我们说明了少数几行没有纳入最终研究样本的原因，再保存一份「可直接分析的数据集」。

examples.en: The tutor asked whether the analysis-ready dataset still contained the field needed for comparisons across the two terms.
examples.zh: 导师问，「可直接分析的数据集」中是否仍有比较两个学期所需的字段。

words.enDefinition: data organised into rows and columns where columns normally describe distinct fields

examples.en: We converted the booking log into tabular data with one row for each recorded reservation.
examples.zh: 我们把预订日志转换为「表格数据」，每条已记录预订占一行。

examples.en: The exercise took tabular data from a small catalogue and calculated the number of items in each category.
examples.zh: 练习从一份小型目录读取「表格数据」，计算每个类别的条目数。

words.enDefinition: a two-dimensional data structure with labelled row and column axes, often supporting columns of different types

examples.en: We stored the workshop dates and attendance counts together in a data frame for the reporting exercise.
examples.zh: 我们把工作坊日期和出勤人数存入同一个「数据框」，供报表练习使用。

examples.en: The data frame kept the room name as text and the seat count as an integer.
examples.zh: 「数据框」以文本存储教室名称，以整数存储座位数。

words.enDefinition: a one-dimensional pandas data object containing values and an associated index of labels

examples.en: We extracted a pandas Series containing daily attendance totals and checked its first three dates.
examples.zh: 我们提取一个包含每日出勤总数的「pandas 一维带标签数组」，核对了其中最早的三个日期。

examples.en: The tutor used a pandas Series to show that row labels could differ from numerical positions.
examples.zh: 导师用「pandas 一维带标签数组」说明行标签可以与数值位置不同。

words.enDefinition: the label used to identify or select a row in a data structure with labelled axes

examples.en: The row label recorded the experiment date, even though the observations were entered out of order.
examples.zh: 「行标签」记录实验日期，尽管观测结果是乱序录入的。

examples.en: We checked the row label before replacing the reading that had been assigned to the wrong date.
examples.zh: 替换被填到错误日期的读数之前，我们核对了「行标签」。

collocations: select a row by its row label

words.enDefinition: the name or other label identifying a column in a data frame or similar table

examples.en: We changed the column label to include the measurement unit before sharing the table with our class.
examples.zh: 和同学分享表格之前，我们改了「列标签」，让它写明计量单位。

examples.en: The column label was repeated twice because the two forms used the same question heading.
examples.zh: 两个表单使用了同样的问题标题，所以这个「列标签」出现了两次。

collocations: check for a duplicate column label

words.enDefinition: matching values on labelled indexes so operations combine corresponding labels rather than positions

examples.en: The index alignment matched readings by date although the two source lists had been sorted differently.
examples.zh: 尽管两份原始列表的排序不同，「索引对齐」仍然按日期匹配各项读数。

examples.en: We checked index alignment after addition produced missing values for dates appearing in only one input.
examples.zh: 两份数据相加时，仅在其中一份出现的日期对应结果为缺失值，于是我们检查了「索引对齐」。

collocations: handle missing values after index alignment

words.enDefinition: a sequence or array of Boolean selections marking which values or positions to keep or operate on

examples.en: We built a Boolean mask to keep only records whose temperature fell within the instrument's valid range.
examples.zh: 我们创建「布尔掩码」，只保留温度处于仪器有效范围内的记录。

examples.en: The tutor displayed the Boolean mask next to the original values so we could see which rows stayed.
examples.zh: 导师把「布尔掩码」和原始值并列显示，让我们看出保留了哪些行。

words.enDefinition: selecting data using labels assigned to rows or columns

examples.en: The example used label-based indexing to read the entries whose row labels matched two specific dates.
examples.zh: 示例使用「按标签索引」，读取行标签匹配两个指定日期的条目。

examples.en: We used label-based indexing to select columns by name after another group had rearranged the table.
examples.zh: 另一组重新排列了表格后，我们用「按标签索引」根据列名选列。

collocations: compare label-based indexing with position-based indexing

words.enDefinition: selecting data by numerical row or column position rather than assigned labels

examples.en: We used position-based indexing to inspect the first two rows regardless of their date labels.
examples.zh: 我们用「按位置索引」查看前两行，无需关心它们的日期标签。

examples.en: The tutor explained position-based indexing after sorting moved the largest observation to a different row number.
examples.zh: 排序把最大观测值移到另一个行号后，导师讲解了「按位置索引」。

collocations: slice a table using position-based indexing

words.enDefinition: an index whose labels contain several levels, such as a year and a month

examples.en: We set a multi-level index so the attendance data could be located by building and room together.
examples.zh: 我们设置「多级索引」，以便同时用楼宇和房间定位出勤数据。

examples.en: The multi-level index kept months under their corresponding years in the reshaped workshop summary.
examples.zh: 重塑后的工作坊汇总表通过「多级索引」把各月归到对应年份下面。

collocations: select a level of a multi-level index

words.enDefinition: to replace the current index with a new default index, optionally preserving old labels as columns

examples.en: We had to reset the index after filtering left the remaining rows with gaps in their numbers.
examples.zh: 筛选使剩余行的编号不连续，所以我们需要「重置索引」。

examples.en: The tutor chose to reset the index and keep the old labels for later comparison.
examples.zh: 导师决定「重置索引」，并保留旧标签供之后比较。

collocations: reset the index without dropping the labels
choose when to reset the index

words.enDefinition: to change the labels of table columns without changing their values

examples.en: We needed to rename columns before joining files whose authors used different headings for the same measurements.
examples.zh: 文件作者用不同标题表示同一测量项，我们需要先「重命名列」再合并。

examples.en: Our instructor asked us to rename columns so each label identified both the field and its unit.
examples.zh: 讲师让我们「重命名列」，让各标签同时标明字段和单位。

collocations: rename columns by their old labels

words.enDefinition: examining a dataset's structure, value distributions and signs of data quality problems

examples.en: The data profiling report showed that one department used three spellings for the same room name.
examples.zh: 「数据概况分析」报告显示，一个部门给同一教室名称用了三种拼法。

examples.en: We performed data profiling before deciding which values to repair and which to leave unchanged.
examples.zh: 我们先做「数据概况分析」，再决定修复哪些值、保留哪些值。

collocations: summarise the results of data profiling

words.enDefinition: a summary of properties of one column, often covering its value types, counts and distribution

examples.en: The column profile listed the smallest and largest valid distances and the number of unrecorded measurements.
examples.zh: 「列概况」列出最小及最大的有效距离，以及未记录的测量次数。

examples.en: We compared a new column profile with the original one after standardising several category labels.
examples.zh: 统一了几个类别标签后，我们把新的「列概况」与原来的列概况作了比较。

words.enDefinition: a requirement on the format, range, relationships or other permitted properties of data

examples.en: A data validation rule prevented the classroom exercise from accepting a completion date before the start date.
examples.zh: 「数据校验规则」使课堂练习拒绝早于开始日期的完成日期。

examples.en: We wrote a data validation rule for the unit field after finding three unexplained abbreviations.
examples.zh: 我们找出三个没有解释的缩写后，为单位字段写了「数据校验规则」。

collocations: report a failed data validation rule

words.enDefinition: a check that required entries, fields or records are present

examples.en: The completeness check flagged two sign-in forms that did not contain the session date.
examples.zh: 「完整性检查」标记了两张没有活动日期的签到表。

examples.en: We ran a completeness check to see whether all the expected weekly files had arrived.
examples.zh: 我们做了「完整性检查」，查看所有预期的周文件是否已经收到。

words.enDefinition: testing whether selected values or combinations occur at most once in the expected scope

examples.en: The uniqueness check caught a repeated room identifier in the sheet prepared for the class exercise.
examples.zh: 「唯一性检查」在为课堂练习准备的表中找到了一个重复的房间标识符。

examples.en: We repeated the uniqueness check on the pair of columns that identified an individual booking.
examples.zh: 我们对共同标识单条预订的两列再次做了「唯一性检查」。

collocations: apply a uniqueness check to two columns

words.enDefinition: uniform use of a required representation for equivalent kinds of data

examples.en: We checked format consistency because some files recorded dates with slashes and others used hyphens.
examples.zh: 我们检查了「格式一致性」，因为有些文件的日期用斜杠分隔，有些用连字符。

examples.en: The import improved format consistency by storing every room code with the same number of characters.
examples.zh: 导入时将所有房间编号存为相同长度，提升了「格式一致性」。

words.enDefinition: a test that a numeric value falls within permitted bounds

examples.en: The numeric range check found a negative count in the file containing event registrations.
examples.zh: 「数值范围检查」在活动报名文件中发现了一处负数计数。

examples.en: We added a numeric range check after confirming the minimum and maximum supported by the device.
examples.zh: 确认设备支持的最小值与最大值之后，我们加入了「数值范围检查」。

words.enDefinition: the defined labels a categorical field is allowed to contain

examples.en: The list of permitted categories contained one entry for each location used in the study.
examples.zh: 「允许的类别」清单为研究用到的每个地点各设一个条目。

examples.en: We compared the submitted labels with the permitted categories before reporting the number of invalid entries.
examples.zh: 报告无效条目的数量前，我们将已提交的标签与「允许的类别」作了比较。

words.enDefinition: a record whose layout or representation does not follow the expected input format

examples.en: The reader flagged a malformed record where an unclosed quote combined fields from two separate addresses.
examples.zh: 一处引号未闭合，把两个地址的字段连到了一起，读取程序标记了这条「格式有误的记录」。

examples.en: We inspected the malformed record before deciding whether its fields could be recovered from the file.
examples.zh: 我们先查看「格式有误的记录」，再决定是否能从文件恢复其中字段。

words.enDefinition: more than one kind of value, such as text and numbers, appearing in an expected homogeneous column

examples.en: The mixed data types caused a totals calculation to skip values that had been stored as text.
examples.zh: 由于存在「混合的数据类型」，求合计时跳过了以文本存储的数值。

examples.en: We traced the mixed data types to two groups that exported the same question in different formats.
examples.zh: 我们查到「混合的数据类型」源于两个小组以不同格式导出了同一道题。

collocations: scan a column for mixed data types

words.enDefinition: to remove whitespace characters from both ends of text while keeping the interior unchanged

examples.en: We used a text operation to trim leading and trailing whitespace before matching music titles from two files.
examples.zh: 匹配两份文件里的曲名前，我们用文本操作「去除首尾空白」。

examples.en: The tutor asked us to trim leading and trailing whitespace so labels would match the allowed list.
examples.zh: 导师要求我们「去除首尾空白」，使标签与允许值的清单匹配。

collocations: trim leading and trailing whitespace before matching
trim leading and trailing whitespace from a title
remember to trim leading and trailing whitespace

words.enDefinition: to make different spellings or names for the same category use one agreed label

examples.en: We chose to standardise category labels after finding both Library and library in the same list.
examples.zh: 发现同一清单里同时出现 Library 和 library 后，我们决定「统一类别标签」。

examples.en: The exercise asked us to standardise category labels before comparing survey responses across two classes.
examples.zh: 练习要求我们先「统一类别标签」，再比较两个班的问卷答复。

collocations: use a lookup table to standardise category labels

words.enDefinition: expressing a measured quantity in another unit while preserving the underlying quantity

examples.en: We applied unit conversion before adding distance readings entered in both centimetres and metres.
examples.zh: 累计以厘米和米录入的距离前，我们先做了「计量单位换算」。

examples.en: A missing unit conversion explained why one station appeared much colder than the others in the report.
examples.zh: 报表里有一个监测站看起来比其他站冷得多，原因是漏做了「计量单位换算」。

words.enDefinition: to interpret a textual or raw time representation as a date and time value

examples.en: We could parse a timestamp only after confirming whether the source used day before month.
examples.zh: 我们确认原数据是否把日在月前，才可以「解析时间戳」。

examples.en: The worksheet showed how to parse a timestamp and keep the offset supplied with the reading.
examples.zh: 练习表演示怎样「解析时间戳」并保留读数附带的时区偏移。

collocations: parse a timestamp using a format
parse a timestamp with an offset

words.enDefinition: a disagreement between the layout of supplied dates and the format expected by a parser or data rule

examples.en: A date format mismatch caused dates from one form to be interpreted with the month and day reversed.
examples.zh: 一处「日期格式不匹配」导致某个表单里的日期被按月日颠倒的方式读取。

examples.en: We detected a date format mismatch because the parser rejected dates only after the twelfth day.
examples.zh: 解析程序只拒绝日数大于十二的日期，我们因此发现了「日期格式不匹配」。

words.enDefinition: a number representing a date by counting days from a spreadsheet system's chosen origin

examples.en: The spreadsheet displayed a date serial number after we changed the example cell to a numeric format.
examples.zh: 我们把示例单元格设为数字格式后，电子表格显示了一个「日期序列号」。

examples.en: The tutor checked which date system defined the date serial number before converting it to a calendar date.
examples.zh: 导师确认了「日期序列号」使用哪套日期系统，才将其转换为日历日期。

collocations: identify the origin of a date serial number

words.enDefinition: a timestamp carrying timezone or offset information that can identify an instant when interpreted under the applicable rules

examples.en: We stored a timezone-aware timestamp so readings collected abroad could be placed on the same timeline.
examples.zh: 我们存储「带时区信息的时间戳」，让在海外采集的读数也能排在同一时间轴上。

examples.en: The tutor converted a timezone-aware timestamp to UTC before comparing it with the time in another file.
examples.zh: 导师将「带时区信息的时间戳」转换为 UTC，再与另一文件中的时间比较。

words.enDefinition: a date and time value that does not carry timezone or offset information

examples.en: We found a naive timestamp in each row and asked the lab which local time was used.
examples.zh: 我们在每一行都找到了「无时区信息的时间戳」，于是询问实验室使用哪个当地时间。

examples.en: The migration converted the naive timestamp only after we identified the location of the original recording device.
examples.zh: 我们确定原始记录设备的位置后，迁移程序才转换「无时区信息的时间戳」。

collocations: attach timezone information to a naive timestamp

words.enDefinition: to assign timezone information to a timestamp that lacks it, preserving the local time where it is valid in that zone

examples.en: We could localise a timestamp only after checking which time zone the instrument used in the field.
examples.zh: 我们先确认仪器在现场使用的时区，才可以「给时间戳指定时区」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked us to localise a timestamp before aligning reports from two different countries.
examples.zh: 导师让我们先「给时间戳指定时区」，再对齐来自两个国家的报告。

collocations: localise a timestamp using the recording site's timezone

words.enDefinition: the level of time detail recorded or represented by a timestamp

examples.en: The timestamp granularity was one minute, so the example could not order events within the same minute.
examples.zh: 「时间戳粒度」是一分钟，因此示例不能确定同一分钟内各事件的顺序。

examples.en: We checked timestamp granularity before comparing logs from a device that reported only the current hour.
examples.zh: 与一台只报告当前小时的设备日志比较之前，我们核对了「时间戳粒度」。

words.enDefinition: to represent time-indexed observations at a new frequency, often by aggregating or filling intervals

examples.en: We learned to resample a time series by combining hourly rainfall values into daily totals.
examples.zh: 我们将每小时降雨量合计为每日总量，以学习如何「对时间序列重采样」。

examples.en: The tutor asked us to resample a time series so two devices could be compared at matching intervals.
examples.zh: 导师要求我们「对时间序列重采样」，使两台设备的数据能按相同时间间隔比较。

collocations: resample a time series by month
resample a time series to a weekly frequency
resample a time series using a mean

words.enDefinition: organising time-stamped records by calendar year and month rather than by a fixed number of days

examples.en: The calendar month grouping kept February separate even though it had fewer days than the surrounding months.
examples.zh: 尽管二月比前后两个月的天数少，「按自然月分组」仍将二月单独归组。

examples.en: We used calendar month grouping to compare totals with the library's monthly attendance records.
examples.zh: 我们用「按自然月分组」得到合计，再与图书馆的月度到访记录比较。

collocations: report totals using calendar month grouping

words.enDefinition: the size of a numeric interval used to group observations into bins

examples.en: We reduced the bin width from ten minutes to five before looking more closely at waiting times.
examples.zh: 我们把「分箱宽度」从十分钟缩小到五分钟，再仔细查看等待时长。

examples.en: The bin width determined how many intervals covered the range of measurements collected in class.
examples.zh: 「分箱宽度」决定多少个区间能覆盖课堂测量值的范围。

words.enDefinition: a value marking the start or end of a grouping interval

examples.en: We checked which interval included a score of fifty because that value lay exactly on a bin boundary.
examples.zh: 五十分正好位于「分箱边界」，我们确认它归到哪个区间。

examples.en: The first bin boundary was set below the lowest observed temperature in our classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 课堂练习将第一个「分箱边界」设在最低观测温度之下。

collocations: check a value on a bin boundary

words.enDefinition: replacing values from a continuous scale with a finite set of categories or intervals

examples.en: The discretisation step assigned each distance to one of four ranges for the classroom report.
examples.zh: 「离散化」步骤把各距离划入四个区间之一，以便制作课堂报告。

examples.en: We compared values before and after discretisation to see how much precision the summary lost.
examples.zh: 我们比较「离散化」前后的数值，了解汇总损失了多少精度。

words.enDefinition: grouping numeric data into intervals of the same width

examples.en: We used equal-width binning to group the full range of temperatures into five intervals of identical size.
examples.zh: 我们用「等宽分箱」把整个温度范围划入五个等宽区间。

examples.en: The equal-width binning produced one interval with no observations because the readings left a gap there.
examples.zh: 读数在一段范围内没有取值，因此「等宽分箱」产生了一个没有观测值的区间。

collocations: choose cut points for equal-width binning
compare equal-width binning with equal-frequency binning

words.enDefinition: grouping data into intervals intended to contain roughly the same number of observations

examples.en: The tutor used equal-frequency binning to create four groups with similar numbers of observations despite different interval widths.
examples.zh: 导师用「等频分箱」创建四组，各组的观测值数量相近，但区间宽度不同。

examples.en: We checked whether ties prevented equal-frequency binning from dividing the sample into equally populated groups.
examples.zh: 我们检查相同取值是否使「等频分箱」无法把样本划分为条数相同的组。

words.enDefinition: data whose values are categories with a defined order, without assuming equal intervals between categories

examples.en: The survey stored response options as ordered categorical data to keep low, medium and high in order.
examples.zh: 问卷将选项存为「有序类别数据」，使低、中、高保持正确顺序。

examples.en: The tutor sorted the ordered categorical data before printing the table of responses for each training session.
examples.zh: 导师先对「有序类别数据」排序，再打印每场培训的答复表。

collocations: define the levels of ordered categorical data

words.zhGloss: 样本中实际出现的类别
words.enDefinition: the category labels that occur in the selected observations, excluding defined labels with no recorded occurrences
acceptedZhAnswers: 样本中实际出现的类别

examples.en: The observed categories did not include the last option, although it appeared on every printed survey form.
examples.zh: 尽管每张纸质问卷都有最后一个选项，「样本中实际出现的类别」并不包含它。

examples.en: We checked which observed categories changed when the report filtered the data to show morning sessions only.
examples.zh: 我们检查只保留上午活动时，「样本中实际出现的类别」发生了哪些变化。

words.enDefinition: the number of observations assigned to a particular category

examples.en: The category frequency dropped after we removed two forms that recorded the same student's response twice.
examples.zh: 删除两份重复记录同一学生答复的表单后，「类别频数」减少了。

examples.en: We reported both the category frequency and its percentage share in the appendix to the class report.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂报告的附录里同时列出了「类别频数」与它的百分比占比。

words.enDefinition: a table summarising counts or other aggregated values for combinations of categories from two or more variables

examples.en: The cross-tabulation showed how often each rating appeared for the morning and afternoon workshops in the sample.
examples.zh: 「交叉表」显示样本中的上午、下午工作坊各出现多少次不同评级。

examples.en: We built a cross-tabulation of venue and event type after checking that the names were spelled consistently.
examples.zh: 确认场地名称的拼写一致后，我们按场地和活动类型构建了「交叉表」。

words.enDefinition: a total for one row or column of a table across the categories displayed in the other dimension

examples.en: The row's marginal total showed how many respondents selected the option across all four sessions.
examples.zh: 该行的「边际合计」显示四场活动共有多少名答复者选择这个选项。

examples.en: We checked the marginal total at the bottom of each column against the original session counts.
examples.zh: 我们用活动原始人数核查每列底部的「边际合计」。

collocations: display marginal totals around a cross-tabulation

words.enDefinition: the minimum, first quartile, median, third quartile and maximum of a set of numbers

examples.en: We prepared a five-number summary of the waiting times before comparing the longest and shortest observed delays.
examples.zh: 我们先为等待时长制作「五数概括」，再对比观测到的最长和最短延迟。

examples.en: The five-number summary placed the median much closer to the first quartile than the third quartile.
examples.zh: 「五数概括」显示中位数比起第三四分位数，更接近第一四分位数。

words.enDefinition: looking for unusually distant observations using predefined rules or visual inspection before deciding how to treat them

examples.en: The outlier screening identified one extremely long wait, which the supervisor confirmed had actually occurred.
examples.zh: 「异常值筛查」发现一次异常漫长的等待，主管核实这次等待确实发生过。

examples.en: We performed outlier screening to find measurements that needed a closer check against the original records.
examples.zh: 我们做了「异常值筛查」，找出需要和原始记录进一步核对的测量值。

words.enDefinition: a stored indicator identifying an observation for review because it was unusually far from other values

examples.en: The outlier flag marked a reading for review without removing the observation from the original data table.
examples.zh: 「异常值标记」指出一条读数需要复查，但原始数据表仍保留该观测结果。

examples.en: We checked the outlier flag against the source form before interpreting the unusually high temperature.
examples.zh: 解读异常偏高的温度前，我们对照原表核对了「异常值标记」。

collocations: clear an outlier flag after checking

words.enDefinition: a potential-outlier cutoff formed by extending beyond a quartile by a chosen multiple of the interquartile range

examples.en: The tutor calculated an interquartile fence above the third quartile and flagged two unusually large values.
examples.zh: 导师在第三四分位数之上计算了一个「四分位距围栏」，标记两个异常大的值。

examples.en: We chose an interquartile fence for screening before reviewing the observations that exceeded it.
examples.zh: 在复查超过界限的观测值之前，我们先为筛查选定一个「四分位距围栏」。

collocations: flag values outside an interquartile fence

words.enDefinition: checking whether data are credible in context even if they meet the required technical format

examples.en: The plausibility check flagged a negative duration even though the database had accepted it as numeric.
examples.zh: 尽管数据库把负时长当作数字接受了，「合理性检查」还是标出了它。

examples.en: We added a plausibility check for return dates that came before the corresponding loan dates.
examples.zh: 我们增加了「合理性检查」，找出早于对应借出日期的归还日期。

words.enDefinition: a value after an identified error or inconsistency has been corrected or standardised

examples.en: The cleaned value used the official building name after we resolved three spellings in the forms.
examples.zh: 我们确定表单中三种拼法指同一楼宇后，「清洗后的值」采用其正式名称。

examples.en: We kept the original label beside the cleaned value so readers could reproduce the change later.
examples.zh: 我们把原始标签保留在「清洗后的值」旁边，便于读者日后复现这一更改。

collocations: compare a cleaned value with its original

words.enDefinition: an entry for which a value has not been observed or recorded

examples.en: The missing value marked an afternoon session for which the data sheet contained no recorded reading.
examples.zh: 这处「缺失值」对应一场没有在数据表中留下读数的下午活动。

examples.en: We kept the missing value separate from zero because they represented different results in the classroom study.
examples.zh: 由于二者在课堂研究中表示不同情况，我们把「缺失值」与零区分开。

words.enDefinition: a variable marking whether another value is missing for each observation

examples.en: We added a missingness indicator to track which survey responses originally lacked an answer to that question.
examples.zh: 我们添加「缺失指示变量」，追踪哪些问卷答复最初漏答了那道题。

examples.en: The tutor counted the missingness indicator values separately for the morning and afternoon groups in the study.
examples.zh: 导师在研究中分别统计上午组和下午组的「缺失指示变量」取值。

collocations: use a missingness indicator in an analysis

words.enDefinition: the distribution or combination of missing values across observations, variables or groups

examples.en: The missingness pattern showed that several measurements were absent together near the end of the same session.
examples.zh: 「数据缺失模式」显示，几次读数缺失集中在同一场活动快结束时。

examples.en: We looked for a missingness pattern before deciding whether to exclude incomplete records from the comparison.
examples.zh: 我们先查看是否存在「数据缺失模式」，再决定是否从比较中排除不完整的记录。

collocations: check a missingness pattern before analysis

words.enDefinition: a code, token or special value indicating that a data entry is missing

examples.en: The reader recognised the configured missing value marker and did not treat it as a measurement.
examples.zh: 读取程序识别了配置的「缺失值标记符」，没有把它当成测量值。

examples.en: We listed each missing value marker used by the three surveys before combining their files.
examples.zh: 合并三个调查的文件前，我们列出各调查使用的每种「缺失值标记符」。

words.enDefinition: a designated value showing that a question or field does not apply to a particular record

examples.en: The not applicable code meant that the participant had skipped a follow-up question by design.
examples.zh: 「不适用编码」表示按问卷设计，这名参与者不需要回答后续题。

examples.en: We kept the not applicable code distinct from a blank for a required question.
examples.zh: 我们将「不适用编码」与必答题未填的空白分开保留。

collocations: distinguish a not applicable code from a blank

words.enDefinition: the proportion of expected data positions with no recorded value, expressed as a percentage

examples.en: The percentage missing was highest for the optional comments field on the workshop evaluation forms.
examples.zh: 工作坊评价表中，选填的备注字段「缺失比例」最高。

examples.en: We calculated the percentage missing for each group using its own number of expected answers.
examples.zh: 我们分别用各组应有的答复数，计算各组的「缺失比例」。

collocations: compare the percentage missing across columns

words.enDefinition: an analysis restricted to observations with present values for all variables needed in that analysis

examples.en: The complete-case analysis used fewer records because some participants had not supplied values for both measures.
examples.zh: 由于有些参与者没有提供两项度量的值，「完整个案分析」使用了较少的记录。

examples.en: We compared the complete-case analysis with a separate sensitivity check based on a different treatment of missing data.
examples.zh: 我们将「完整个案分析」与按另一种方法处理缺失数据的敏感性检查作了比较。

collocations: report the sample size for a complete-case analysis
compare a complete-case analysis with imputation

words.zhGloss: 按变量对删除缺失记录
words.enDefinition: excluding incomplete observations separately for each pair of variables involved in a calculation
acceptedZhAnswers: 按变量对删除缺失记录

examples.en: The pairwise deletion method used different numbers of records for two correlations shown in the results.
examples.zh: 结果中两组相关性用了不同数量的记录，这是因为采用了「按变量对删除缺失记录」。

examples.en: Our tutor checked the sample count for each estimate after the worksheet applied pairwise deletion.
examples.zh: 练习表采用「按变量对删除缺失记录」之后，导师核查了每个估计使用的样本数。

collocations: report sample counts after pairwise deletion
compare pairwise deletion with complete-case analysis

words.enDefinition: to replace a missing entry with an estimated or assigned value according to a specified method

examples.en: The tutor asked whether we could impute a missing value without adding information from later measurements.
examples.zh: 导师问，我们能否不引入日后测量的信息，直接「插补一个缺失值」。

examples.en: We chose to impute a missing value only after checking how many observations lacked that measure.
examples.zh: 我们先核查多少观测没有该测量值，再决定「插补一个缺失值」。

collocations: impute a missing value using a model
choose how to impute a missing value
document the decision to impute a missing value

words.enDefinition: replacing missing numeric entries with the mean of a specified set of observed values

examples.en: The practice report used mean imputation to fill a few blanks and explained why variability might shrink.
examples.zh: 练习报告用「均值插补」填补几处空白，并说明数据变异可能缩小的原因。

examples.en: We applied mean imputation using only the readings assigned to the reference sample before the comparison.
examples.zh: 比较前，我们仅用参考样本的读数进行「均值插补」。

collocations: use mean imputation for a numeric field
assess the effect of mean imputation

words.enDefinition: replacing missing numeric entries with the median of a specified set of observed values

examples.en: Our lesson illustrated median imputation using a table whose observed waiting times included one extremely long delay.
examples.zh: 课堂用一张等待时长表演示「中位数插补」，其中有一次等待特别长。

examples.en: The team documented the reference group used for median imputation so the results could be reproduced.
examples.zh: 团队记录了「中位数插补」所用的参考组，使结果可复现。

collocations: compare median imputation with mean imputation
record the source values for median imputation

words.enDefinition: filling a missing value with the most frequently occurring value in a specified observed set

examples.en: The classroom report tested mode imputation for the missing entries in a field of venue categories.
examples.zh: 课堂报告对一列场地类别中的缺失条目试用了「众数插补」。

examples.en: We checked whether two categories were tied before using mode imputation in the practice dataset.
examples.zh: 在练习数据集中使用「众数插补」前，我们核查了是否有两个类别的频数并列最高。

collocations: apply mode imputation to a category
handle tied modes in mode imputation

words.enDefinition: filling missing entries using an estimation or replacement rule fitted or calculated separately within groups

examples.en: Our example used groupwise imputation so missing travel times were filled from the same campus location.
examples.zh: 示例采用「按组插补」，用校内同一地点的数据填补缺失的行程用时。

examples.en: The tutor checked for groups with no observed values before applying groupwise imputation to the file.
examples.zh: 导师检查是否有整组没有观测值，再对文件做「按组插补」。

collocations: check group size before groupwise imputation

words.enDefinition: filling missing positions with the most recent available value earlier in an ordered sequence

examples.en: A forward fill carried the last recorded room setting into later empty cells until another setting appeared.
examples.zh: 「前向填充」把最近记录的教室设置带入之后的空单元格，直到有新设置出现。

examples.en: We limited forward fill to a single session so values could not carry over into another day.
examples.zh: 我们把「前向填充」限制在单场活动内，使数值不会延续到第二天。

collocations: limit the length of a forward fill
use forward fill within each group

words.enDefinition: filling missing positions with the next available value later in an ordered sequence

examples.en: The example used backward fill to copy the next recorded label into an empty preceding position.
examples.zh: 示例使用「后向填充」把后续第一个已记录标签复制到它之前的空位置。

examples.en: We avoided backward fill in our forecasting exercise because future observations were unavailable at prediction time.
examples.zh: 我们在预测练习中避免了「后向填充」，因为预测时还拿不到未来观测结果。

collocations: limit the length of a backward fill
compare backward fill with forward fill

words.enDefinition: estimating an intermediate value from the straight line between two known values

examples.en: The exercise used linear interpolation to estimate the temperature between two readings taken ten minutes apart.
examples.zh: 练习用「线性插值」估计两次间隔十分钟的读数之间的温度。

examples.en: We compared linear interpolation with backup observations that covered the gap left by our primary instrument.
examples.zh: 我们用备用观测值覆盖主仪器留下的缺口，并与「线性插值」的结果作对比。

collocations: estimate a value by linear interpolation

words.enDefinition: a gap between observed positions where values could be estimated using interpolation

examples.en: We measured the interpolation gap before deciding whether the nearest readings were too far apart to use.
examples.zh: 我们先测量「待插值的区间」，再判断最近的两条读数之间是否相隔太远。

examples.en: The tutor left the interpolation gap unchanged because there were no observations from that entire afternoon.
examples.zh: 由于整个下午都没有观测值，导师没有填补这个「待插值的区间」。

collocations: limit the length of an interpolation gap

words.enDefinition: a data row repeating another row's values under the chosen comparison fields

examples.en: The file contained a duplicate row because the same completed form was entered twice by accident.
examples.zh: 同一份已填表单不慎录入两次，因此文件包含一条「重复行」。

examples.en: We verified the duplicate row against the source before removing one of the two copies.
examples.zh: 我们先用来源数据核对「重复行」，再删去两条中的一条。

words.enDefinition: an index or column label appearing more than once on the same axis

examples.en: The duplicate label meant selecting that date returned two rows from the example data frame.
examples.zh: 由于存在「重复标签」，按该日期选择时会从示例数据框返回两行。

examples.en: We changed one duplicate label after discovering that two columns both had the heading Attendance.
examples.zh: 发现有两列标题都叫 Attendance 后，我们修改了其中一个「重复标签」。

words.enDefinition: a repeated key value or combination that is expected to identify a unique record

examples.en: The reader reported a duplicate key because two catalogue entries had been assigned the same code.
examples.zh: 两条目录记录被分配了相同编码，因此读取程序报告了「重复键值」。

examples.en: We inspected the duplicate key before deciding which of the two room records needed correction.
examples.zh: 在确定两条房间记录中哪一条需要更正前，我们核对了「重复键值」。

collocations: check which records share a duplicate key

words.enDefinition: a rule specifying which records count as duplicates and which representative to retain

examples.en: Our deduplication rule kept the most recently approved version when the same booking appeared several times.
examples.zh: 同一预订出现多次时，我们的「去重规则」保留最近获批的版本。

examples.en: We tested the deduplication rule on two records with matching dates but different venues.
examples.zh: 我们用两条日期相同、场地不同的记录测试了「去重规则」。

words.enDefinition: the version of a record designated to represent an entity across several source records

examples.en: We chose the verified address entry as the canonical record after checking the competing sources.
examples.zh: 核对各个不同来源之后，我们选经核实的地址条目作为「权威记录」。

examples.en: The canonical record kept the approved course name and a link to its earlier spellings.
examples.zh: 「权威记录」保留经批准的课程名称，并记录它与早期不同拼法的关联。

collocations: link an alias to a canonical record

words.enDefinition: identifying records from one or more sources that refer to the same underlying entity

examples.en: The project used record linkage to match official room entries with an older handwritten inventory.
examples.zh: 项目通过「记录链接」把正式房间条目与一份较早的手写清单对应起来。

examples.en: We reviewed borderline record linkage results by checking the building codes recorded alongside similar names.
examples.zh: 我们核对相近名称旁记录的楼宇代码，以复查拿不准的「记录链接」结果。

words.enDefinition: a matching rule requiring identical values for the chosen comparison fields under stated normalisation

examples.en: The exact match rule compared both the workshop code and its recorded date in our exercise.
examples.zh: 我们的练习用「精确匹配规则」同时比较工作坊编号和记录日期。

examples.en: We used an exact match rule after standardising the extra spaces in the library codes.
examples.zh: 统一清除图书馆编号中的多余空格后，我们采用「精确匹配规则」。

words.enDefinition: finding possible matches using similarity rules when the compared values may differ in spelling or representation

examples.en: We used fuzzy matching to suggest catalogue names that differed by one character in the two files.
examples.zh: 我们用「模糊匹配」给出两份文件中仅相差一个字符的目录名称候选。

examples.en: The tutor reviewed fuzzy matching results before accepting any proposed pair of nearly identical school names.
examples.zh: 导师先复查「模糊匹配」结果，再接受任何一对近乎相同的学校名称。

collocations: set a similarity threshold for fuzzy matching

words.enDefinition: a proposed match with more than one plausible candidate, or insufficient evidence to choose confidently

examples.en: The ambiguous match involved two venues with identical names but different addresses in the practice inventory.
examples.zh: 这条「无法唯一确定的匹配」涉及练习清单里两处同名但不同地址的场地。

examples.en: We marked an ambiguous match for manual review rather than linking either candidate automatically.
examples.zh: 我们标记一条「无法唯一确定的匹配」供人工复查，避免自动链接任何一个候选。

words.enDefinition: combining tables along a selected axis, such as appending rows while aligning columns

examples.en: The table concatenation added February's survey rows beneath January's after checking that the fields matched.
examples.zh: 核查字段一致后，「表拼接」把二月的问卷行添到一月的下方。

examples.en: We used table concatenation to attach two sets of columns with matching row labels in the example.
examples.zh: 在示例中，我们用「表拼接」并排连接两组行标签相同的列。

collocations: check the result of table concatenation

words.enDefinition: to arrange or match columns between tables using corresponding positions or labels

examples.en: We had to align columns before combining surveys that displayed the same questions in different orders.
examples.zh: 表单以不同顺序显示相同题目，我们先「对齐各列」再合并问卷。

examples.en: The tutor asked us to align columns by their labels before comparing values from separate sources.
examples.zh: 导师要求我们先按标签「对齐各列」，再比较不同来源的值。

collocations: align columns in two data frames

words.enDefinition: a discrepancy in the columns expected and supplied, such as different labels, counts or types

examples.en: A column mismatch appeared because one file used two fields for the address and the other used one.
examples.zh: 一个文件用两个字段存地址，另一个只用一个，因此出现「列不匹配」。

examples.en: We resolved the column mismatch before adding the spring records to the original table.
examples.zh: 我们先解决「列不匹配」，再把春季记录加到原来的表里。

collocations: report a column mismatch during import

words.enDefinition: an output field identifying whether rows in a data merge came from the left input, right input or both

examples.en: We used a merge indicator after an outer merge to identify attendee records without a match.
examples.zh: 我们在外联接后使用「合并来源标记」，找出没有匹配项的出席记录。

examples.en: The merge indicator showed that several classroom codes existed only in the newer inventory.
examples.zh: 「合并来源标记」显示，有几个教室编号只在较新的清单里出现。

words.enDefinition: checking that the uniqueness of join keys on each side matches the intended relationship between inputs

examples.en: Our join cardinality validation failed because the catalogue contained two rows for one product identifier.
examples.zh: 目录里同一个产品标识符出现了两行，因此我们的「联接基数校验」失败。

examples.en: Our join cardinality validation checked that each room code appeared only once on the lookup side.
examples.zh: 我们通过「联接基数校验」，确认用于查找的表中各房间编号只出现一次。

collocations: diagnose a failed join cardinality validation

words.enDefinition: matching records to nearby rather than necessarily equal keys in ordered input, usually under a direction or tolerance rule

examples.en: The as-of join matched each observation to the most recent calibration reading taken before it.
examples.zh: 「按邻近键联接」为各观测值匹配在它之前最近取得的一条校准读数。

examples.en: We set a maximum time difference for the as-of join to avoid linking unrelated test sessions.
examples.zh: 我们给「按邻近键联接」设置最大时间差，避免把无关的测试活动连在一起。

collocations: set a tolerance for an as-of join
match earlier records with an as-of join

words.enDefinition: the share of rows or keys from a specified input that find a match in the other input

examples.en: We measured join coverage using the fraction of room codes with a matching approved description.
examples.zh: 我们根据有对应获批描述的房间编号比例测量「联接匹配覆盖率」。

examples.en: The join coverage improved after we repaired inconsistent identifiers in three of the weekly exports.
examples.zh: 我们修复三份周导出文件中不一致的标识符后，「联接匹配覆盖率」有了提高。

collocations: report join coverage for each input

words.enDefinition: a check explaining how rows are added, combined or removed between two stages in a data process

examples.en: Our row count reconciliation explained why the final worksheet contained fewer records than the initial export.
examples.zh: 我们的「行数核对」说明了为什么最终练习表的记录比最初导出的少。

examples.en: We added a row count reconciliation after the join returned more records than our group had expected.
examples.zh: 联接返回的记录超过我们组的预期后，我们加了一次「行数核对」。

words.enDefinition: changing the arrangement of rows and columns while preserving the meaning of the recorded observations

examples.en: The data reshaping step moved each month's figures from separate columns into a shared value field.
examples.zh: 「数据重塑」步骤把每个月的数字从不同列移入同一个值字段。

examples.en: We compared the file before and after data reshaping to make sure every recorded measurement was still present.
examples.zh: 我们比较「数据重塑」前后的文件，确认保留了所有有记录的测量值。

words.enDefinition: a layout in which several repeated measurements or category values appear in separate columns of the same row

examples.en: The report used wide format to show the four quarterly totals side by side for each campus.
examples.zh: 报告采用「宽表格式」，为各校区并排展示四个季度的合计。

examples.en: We converted the readings to wide format so each instrument had its own column in the table.
examples.zh: 我们将读数转换为「宽表格式」，使表里的每台仪器都有各自的一列。

words.enDefinition: a layout using separate rows for repeated observations, usually with columns identifying their variable or category

examples.en: We used long format to store each temperature reading with its instrument label and recording date.
examples.zh: 我们用「长表格式」存储每条温度读数及其仪器标签和记录日期。

examples.en: The tutor converted the sheet to long format before grouping all readings by month and instrument.
examples.zh: 导师先将表转换为「长表格式」，再按月和仪器对所有读数分组。

collocations: convert a table to long format

words.enDefinition: data arranged so each variable has a column, each observation has a row and each value has a cell

examples.en: The tutor showed tidy data with one row per measurement and separate columns for the value and unit.
examples.zh: 导师展示了「整齐数据」，每次测量各占一行，数值和单位分别占列。

examples.en: We checked whether the table qualified as tidy data after splitting a combined date and score column.
examples.zh: 拆开同时存日期和分数的一列后，我们检查表是否符合「整齐数据」的要求。

collocations: organise a dataset as tidy data
explain the principles of tidy data
convert a table to tidy data

words.enDefinition: a table summarising values by categories arranged along one or both axes

examples.en: The pivot table showed total reservations for each room and weekday in the practice calendar.
examples.zh: 「数据透视表」按房间和星期几显示练习日历上的预订总数。

examples.en: We changed the pivot table to display average attendance instead of totals for the different event types.
examples.zh: 我们更改了「数据透视表」，按活动类型显示平均出勤人数，替换原先的合计。

collocations: choose a summary function for a pivot table

words.enDefinition: to turn categories stored across rows into separate columns associated with the same observation keys

examples.en: The tidyr tutorial asked us to pivot wider so each test date appeared as a column.
examples.zh: tidyr 教程要求我们「转为更宽的表」，让各测试日期分别占一列。

examples.en: We could pivot wider only after deciding what to do with repeated measures for the same date.
examples.zh: 我们先决定怎样处理同一日期的重复测量，才可以「转为更宽的表」。

words.enDefinition: to move multiple columns into rows, using new fields for the original column labels and their values

examples.en: We used tidyr to pivot longer because monthly readings were originally stored in twelve separate columns.
examples.zh: 原来的月度读数分开存于十二列，因此我们用 tidyr「转为更长的表」。

examples.en: The instructor chose to pivot longer and keep the former column headings in a new category field.
examples.zh: 讲师决定「转为更长的表」，将原来的列标题存入新建的类别字段。

collocations: choose labels when you pivot longer

words.enDefinition: to move one level of a row index onto the columns of a reshaped table

examples.en: We chose to unstack an index level so the summary had separate columns for the different survey outcomes.
examples.zh: 我们「将索引层级转为列」，让各类调查结果在汇总表中分别占列。

examples.en: The exercise asked us to unstack an index level while leaving the year as the row label.
examples.zh: 练习要求我们「将索引层级转为列」，并保留年份作为行标签。

collocations: unstack an index level by name
unstack an index level in a summary
unstack an index level into columns

words.enDefinition: to turn each element of list values in a column into its own row, repeating other fields as needed

examples.en: We needed to explode a list column so each book appeared once per subject tag it carried.
examples.zh: 我们需要「将列表列拆成多行」，使每本书为它的各个主题标签各占一行。

examples.en: The tutor showed how to explode a list column without losing the corresponding catalogue numbers.
examples.zh: 导师演示了如何「将列表列拆成多行」，同时保留对应的目录编号。

collocations: explode a list column into rows
explode a list column while retaining the index
decide when to explode a list column

words.enDefinition: to create separate columns from the components stored together in one column

examples.en: We had to split a column that contained both the room code and the time slot.
examples.zh: 有一列同时存放教室编号和时间段，我们必须「拆分一列」。

examples.en: The tutor chose to split a column using the first comma so later commas remained in the notes.
examples.zh: 导师决定用第一个逗号「拆分一列」，这样后面的逗号仍保留在备注里。

collocations: split a column at a delimiter
split a column into two fields

words.enDefinition: to build one column by combining values drawn from two or more existing columns

examples.en: We chose to combine columns containing year and month before parsing them as a single date field.
examples.zh: 我们决定先「合并多列」，将年份和月份拼在一起，再将其解析为一个日期字段。

examples.en: The exercise asked us to combine columns so every address had one display label for the report.
examples.zh: 练习要求我们「合并多列」，让报表中的每个地址都只有一个展示标签。

words.enDefinition: applying an operation to an entire vector or array through a bulk interface rather than an explicit element loop

examples.en: A vectorised operation converted the full column from centimetres to metres in a single expression.
examples.zh: 「向量化操作」用一个表达式将整列从厘米换算为米。

examples.en: We replaced a loop with a vectorised operation that added a fixed offset to every recorded depth.
examples.zh: 我们用「向量化操作」替换循环，给每个已记录的深度值加上同一偏移量。

collocations: apply a vectorised operation to a column
replace a loop with a vectorised operation

words.enDefinition: an operation applied separately to each row using values associated with the row

examples.en: A row-wise operation compared the start and finish recorded in each row to calculate its duration.
examples.zh: 「逐行操作」比较每行记录的起止时间，计算其时长。

examples.en: We checked whether the row-wise operation returned one scalar per row or a new set of column values.
examples.zh: 我们确认这个「逐行操作」对每行返回一个标量还是一组新的列值。

words.enDefinition: an operation performed on each column as a separate set of values

examples.en: The column-wise operation computed the number of complete entries in each of the survey's numeric fields.
examples.zh: 「逐列操作」统计调查各个数值字段中完整条目的数量。

examples.en: We used a column-wise operation because each measurement type needed its own mean in the summary.
examples.zh: 我们用「逐列操作」，因为汇总中每种测量类型都需要分别计算均值。

collocations: compute statistics with a column-wise operation

words.enDefinition: a workflow that divides data into groups, applies a function to each group and combines their results

examples.en: The tutor demonstrated split-apply-combine by computing one attendance average for each room in the practice dataset.
examples.zh: 导师对练习数据集中的每间教室各算一个出勤均值，以演示「分组、应用、合并」。

examples.en: Our split-apply-combine workflow kept each site separate until its monthly figures had been calculated.
examples.zh: 我们的「分组、应用、合并」流程先分开各地点，算出各自的月度数字再汇总。

words.enDefinition: a calculation done within each group that returns a value aligned with each original observation

examples.en: The groupwise transformation placed the corresponding site average beside every original measurement in the file.
examples.zh: 「按组变换」将对应地点的平均值放到文件中每条原始测量记录旁。

examples.en: We used a groupwise transformation because the table needed to retain the individual readings for later checks.
examples.zh: 我们用「按组变换」，因为表格还需保留各条读数供之后核对。

collocations: check index alignment in a groupwise transformation
retain rows with a groupwise transformation

words.enDefinition: combining observations within each group into summary results such as group totals

examples.en: The groupwise aggregation reduced repeated readings to one total for each instrument and day.
examples.zh: 「按组汇总」把重复测量的读数按仪器和日期分别做了合计。

examples.en: We used groupwise aggregation to produce a separate response count for each age band in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 我们用「按组汇总」，对课堂示例里各年龄段的答复分别计数。

collocations: choose a summary function for groupwise aggregation
compare the results of groupwise aggregation

words.enDefinition: a moving group of adjacent observations used to recalculate a statistic as the current position changes

examples.en: The rolling window held the current observation and four preceding values for each median calculation.
examples.zh: 每次计算中位数时，「滚动窗口」包含当前观测值和之前四个值。

examples.en: We made the rolling window shorter so the reported statistic would respond sooner to an abrupt change.
examples.zh: 我们缩短了「滚动窗口」，使报告的统计量更快反映突变。

collocations: compute a statistic within a rolling window

words.zhGloss: 按时间确定的滚动窗口
words.enDefinition: a moving group of observations selected by elapsed time rather than by a fixed number of rows
acceptedZhAnswers: 按时间确定的滚动窗口

examples.en: The time-based rolling window included all readings during the previous hour even when some readings were delayed.
examples.zh: 「按时间确定的滚动窗口」包含过去一小时内的所有读数，即使有些读数延迟了。

examples.en: We chose a time-based rolling window because the intervals between measurements were different across the files.
examples.zh: 各文件的测量间隔不同，因此我们采用「按时间确定的滚动窗口」。

collocations: set the duration of a time-based rolling window
compare time-based and count-based rolling windows

words.enDefinition: an earlier value aligned with a later observation by a specified number of periods or positions

examples.en: We compared each attendance count with its lagged value from the previous week in the class exercise.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂练习里把每个出勤数与其上周的「滞后值」比较。

examples.en: The first row had no lagged value because the records started on the date shown there.
examples.zh: 第一行没有「滞后值」，因为记录从该行所示日期开始。

collocations: compare an observation with its lagged value

words.enDefinition: a later value aligned with an earlier observation by a specified number of periods or positions

examples.en: The report used the next week's count as a lead value to compare neighbouring observations in the sequence.
examples.zh: 报告将下周的数量作为「前导值」，以比较序列中相邻观测。

examples.en: We excluded the lead value from the forecasting inputs because it would not yet be available in practice.
examples.zh: 我们没把「前导值」用作预测输入，因为实际预测时还拿不到该值。

collocations: check whether a lead value is available

words.enDefinition: the current value in an ordered sequence minus the immediately preceding value

examples.en: The first difference showed how much the number of bookings changed from one day to the next.
examples.zh: 「一阶差分」显示预订数从一天到下一天变化多少。

examples.en: The tutor showed why first difference produced an empty entry at the start of the example series.
examples.zh: 导师说明了为什么「一阶差分」使示例序列的第一项为空。

collocations: apply a first difference to a time series

words.enDefinition: the median recomputed at each position over the currently selected moving window

examples.en: The rolling median remained steady when a single unusually high reading entered the five-value window.
examples.zh: 一条特别高的读数进入包含五个值的窗口时，「滚动中位数」仍保持稳定。

examples.en: We compared the rolling median across two window lengths before interpreting the change in typical waiting time.
examples.zh: 解释典型等待时长的变化之前，我们比较了两种窗口长度下的「滚动中位数」。

collocations: choose a window for the rolling median

words.enDefinition: the number of qualifying observations seen so far in a specified order

examples.en: The cumulative count reached six after the last workshop's attendance form had been added to the group.
examples.zh: 最后一场工作坊的出勤表纳入该组后，「累计计数」达到了六。

examples.en: We restarted the cumulative count at the beginning of each session in the sequence of recorded events.
examples.zh: 在记录的活动序列中，每场开始时我们重新进行「累计计数」。

words.enDefinition: representing category labels with agreed codes while preserving their category meanings

examples.en: Our categorical coding used separate numbers for rooms without treating those numbers as a measure of room size.
examples.zh: 我们的「类别编码」为不同房间使用不同数字，但没有把数字当作房间大小。

examples.en: We documented categorical coding so the next group could trace each label back to its original category.
examples.zh: 我们记录了「类别编码」，使下一组能将各标记追溯到原类别。

words.enDefinition: to turn values that cannot be parsed during conversion into missing entries instead of raising a conversion error for them

examples.en: We chose to coerce invalid values to missing when the demonstration file showed letters in its score field.
examples.zh: 示例文件的分数字段出现字母时，我们选择「将无效值转为缺失」。

examples.en: The tutor counted the rejected dates before asking us to coerce invalid values to missing.
examples.zh: 导师统计了被拒绝的日期，再让我们「将无效值转为缺失」。

collocations: choose to coerce invalid values to missing
coerce invalid values to missing during conversion
log attempts to coerce invalid values to missing

words.enDefinition: a defined representation for transferring data between separate systems or tools

examples.en: The class selected a data interchange format that both the spreadsheet and analysis tools could read.
examples.zh: 同学们选了一种电子表格与分析工具都能读的「数据交换格式」。

examples.en: We checked that the data interchange format could preserve the labels from all the sample records.
examples.zh: 我们确认「数据交换格式」能保留所有示例记录的标签。

collocations: export in a data interchange format
read a supported data interchange format

words.enDefinition: a tabular text format that uses commas to separate fields, with quoting rules where needed

examples.en: The project exported comma-separated values so the class could open the timetable in several different tools.
examples.zh: 项目导出「逗号分隔值」文件，以便同学们用不同工具打开日程表。

examples.en: We checked how comma-separated values represented an address that contained a comma within the address text.
examples.zh: 我们核查了「逗号分隔值」格式如何表示文本本身包含逗号的地址。

collocations: read a file of comma-separated values

words.enDefinition: the character used to separate fields in a text record under the file's format rules

examples.en: The tutor set the delimiter character to a tab because some names contained commas or spaces.
examples.zh: 由于有些名称包含逗号或空格，导师把「字段分隔字符」设为制表符。

examples.en: We checked the delimiter character before importing a text file that placed hyphens inside its record identifiers.
examples.zh: 我们导入一份记录标识符内部含连字符的文本文件之前，核查了「字段分隔字符」。

words.enDefinition: a delimited-file field enclosed by quote markers, often to preserve separators or line breaks inside its value

examples.en: The parser treated the full address as a quoted field even though the address contained two commas.
examples.zh: 尽管地址含两个逗号，解析程序仍将完整地址当作一个「带引号的字段」。

examples.en: We checked the quoted field rules before importing notes that included actual quote characters in the text.
examples.zh: 导入文本中含实际引号的备注前，我们查了「带引号的字段」的规则。

collocations: escape a quote inside a quoted field

words.enDefinition: a row listing the column labels rather than containing an ordinary data observation

examples.en: The header row identified the columns in the timetable before the first actual booking record appeared.
examples.zh: 第一条实际预订记录之前，「标题行」标明了日程表各列。

examples.en: We removed an extra header row that had been repeated in the middle of the combined file.
examples.zh: 我们删除了在合并文件中部重复出现的一条多余「标题行」。

words.enDefinition: determining likely column types from the values in a dataset instead of receiving the types explicitly

examples.en: The reader's data type inference recognised attendance counts as integers and letter-prefixed booking codes as text.
examples.zh: 读取程序通过「数据类型推断」将出勤人数识别为整数，将有字母前缀的预订代码识别为文本。

examples.en: We reviewed data type inference when a numeric column became text after adding the spring files.
examples.zh: 加入春季文件后，一列从数值变成文本，于是我们复查了「数据类型推断」。

collocations: check the result of data type inference

words.enDefinition: column data types declared by the user or schema rather than inferred from observed values

examples.en: We provided explicit column types so the reader would keep leading zeros in the classroom identifiers.
examples.zh: 我们提供「显式指定的列类型」，让读取程序保留教室标识符的前导零。

examples.en: The tutor compared explicit column types with the reader's guesses for a file containing several missing entries.
examples.zh: 导师把「显式指定的列类型」和读取程序对含多个缺失条目的文件所推测的类型作了比较。

collocations: read a file with explicit column types

words.enDefinition: reading a large file in successive groups of records instead of loading it all into memory at once

examples.en: The example used chunked file reading to count records without keeping every row in memory together.
examples.zh: 示例用「分批读取文件」来统计记录，无需将所有行同时放进内存。

examples.en: We added the separate counts from chunked file reading before checking the total against the reference file.
examples.zh: 我们把「分批读取文件」得到的各批计数相加，再与参考文件核对总数。

collocations: choose a group size for chunked file reading
aggregate results from chunked file reading

words.enDefinition: a failure to interpret input according to its expected grammar or data format

examples.en: The parsing error pointed to a line in the sample file with one more field than expected.
examples.zh: 「解析错误」指向示例文件中比预期多出一个字段的那一行。

examples.en: We logged the parsing error with its original record before checking whether the format had changed.
examples.zh: 我们记录「解析错误」及其原始记录，再检查格式是否改变。

collocations: handle a parsing error during import

words.enDefinition: a result indicating that input did not meet one or more recorded requirements

examples.en: The validation failure showed that a recorded reading was outside the classroom instrument's permitted range.
examples.zh: 「校验失败」表明，有一个读数超出了课堂仪器允许的范围。

examples.en: We reviewed the validation failure before deciding whether to correct the value or ask the source team.
examples.zh: 我们先查看「校验失败」，再决定是更正该值，还是询问数据来源小组。

collocations: report the cause of a validation failure

words.enDefinition: a record describing changes that corrected erroneous or inconsistent values and the reasons for those changes

examples.en: The data correction log recorded why a month was changed after we checked the paper registration form.
examples.zh: 我们核查纸质报名表并修改月份后，在「数据更正记录」里写明了原因。

examples.en: We reviewed the data correction log to confirm which original values had been preserved in a separate file.
examples.zh: 我们查看「数据更正记录」，确认哪些原始值保存在另一个文件里。

collocations: document a decision in a data correction log

words.enDefinition: a key value in one source for which no corresponding key was found in another source

examples.en: The unmatched identifier pointed to a room listed under an earlier code in the paper inventory.
examples.zh: 「未匹配到的标识符」指向纸质清单中用旧代码列出的一间房。

examples.en: We checked each unmatched identifier before calculating how many workshop locations had approved descriptions.
examples.zh: 计算多少工作坊地点拥有获批描述前，我们检查了每个「未匹配到的标识符」。

words.enDefinition: a column that holds recorded or computed values rather than the identifiers describing where they came from

examples.en: The value column contained the recorded temperature while a separate field identified the instrument that produced it.
examples.zh: 「值列」存放温度读数，另一个字段标明产生该读数的仪器。

examples.en: We chose the value column before reshaping the grouped summary so the correct totals appeared across months.
examples.zh: 我们在重塑分组汇总前选定「值列」，使各月显示正确合计。

collocations: reshape a table using the value column

words.enDefinition: a variable used to identify observations or their groups during reshaping or matching

examples.en: The identifier variable kept the original room code attached to each measurement after the table was reshaped.
examples.zh: 表格重塑后，「标识变量」仍把原教室编号与各测量记录关联起来。

examples.en: We used two columns as an identifier variable pair because no room number was unique across campus.
examples.zh: 由于房间号在全校并不唯一，我们将两列结合起来作为一对「标识变量」。

collocations: retain an identifier variable during reshaping
match records using an identifier variable

words.enDefinition: applying a defined rule to change the values or representation of data for a specific purpose

examples.en: The data transformation converted weekly attendance counts into percentages using the capacity recorded for each room.
examples.zh: 「数据变换」用各教室记录的容量，将每周出勤人数转换为百分比。

examples.en: We documented each data transformation so another group could calculate the same values from the original file.
examples.zh: 我们记录了每项「数据变换」，让另一组能从原始文件算出同样的值。

collocations: verify the result of a data transformation
